Across the boundary from 93:9, the protected figure shifts from passive deprivation to need voiced as asking. In connected recitation, the requester word is joined to the preceding case particle, while the hamza after the long ā gives the word its own small arrest. The same-surah morning opening (93:1) also lets the asking register carry a public-visibility echo without changing the local noun sense. words.prose: {{ar:تَنْهَرْ}} ({{tr:tanhar}}) is the final controlled act: a second-person jussive under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), aimed directly at the addressee. Its imperfect jussive form regulates possible conduct when the requester appears rather than describing a completed rebuke. Its object has already appeared as {{ar:ٱلسَّآئِلَ}} ({{tr:al-sāʾila}}), so the closing verb completes the earlier person rather than introducing a new target. The selected sense is harsh rebuke or verbal repulsion, not every refusal; because the verb is Form I, the prohibition reaches the basic act before intensified patterns. The wider {{ar:ن ه ر}} ({{tr:n-h-r}}) field of river, channel, and daylight is not the local sense, but it gives the rebuke force, cutting, and exposure pressure. The word is also rare as a verb: its only other verbal occurrence is the same kind of prohibition toward parents (17:23). At the ayah boundary it answers the prior final verb of 93:9 with a near-rhyme and a shifted harm domain, moving from overpowering the orphan to harshly repelling the requester. That negative speech restraint then prepares the forward turn to positive speech about blessing in 93:11.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted human noun at word 2 is paired with a second-person prohibition at word 4, so the encounter with the asker, not merely the requested object, is foregrounded.
baseline_models.mechanism: An approach made through asking meets a speech act capable of driving the asker back. The prohibition protects the asker's standing at the moment of dependence; it constrains refusal and manner without by itself promising that every request will be granted.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supply the vulnerable approach and identify the person whose treatment is regulated.
Harsh verbal rebuke supplies the prohibited force that can repel and demean the approaching asker.

changed_reading.before: A narrow etiquette rule says not to use rude words.
changed_reading.after: The command protects the asker's human standing during an asymmetrical request, even when the requested thing cannot be supplied.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The requested-object and fulfillment branches of word 2 coexist with the river and opening branches of the prohibited verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be modeled as a channel between articulated need and possible response. The river image adds movement but also cutting and erosion, while widening-until-flow adds access; negation therefore warns against making the response channel itself wound or sweep aside the requester.

activation_trace.role: The sought request supplies the content that is trying to pass from need into response.
Fulfilling a request supplies a possible endpoint while leaving room for responses short of fulfillment.
A river cutting ground supplies the image of a response channel that can carry provision yet erode social ground.
Opening and widening until flow supply the alternative possibility of keeping access passable rather than closing it by rebuke.

changed_reading.before: The verse regulates the tone of one brief exchange.
changed_reading.after: It also regulates the social channel through which a need becomes answer: do not make that channel cut, wound, or eject the person using it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asker at word 2 can activate reciprocal questioning within its dominant inventory, while word 4 names the verbal act that would terminate exchange.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparently one-way petitioner can be heard as a participant in a question-and-answer relation. Rebuke is then not only discourtesy but a unilateral closure of reciprocity by the party with greater authority.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies a two-sided exchange latent within the figure of the asker.
Harsh rebuke supplies the speech act by which the stronger participant can shut that exchange down.

changed_reading.before: The asker is only a one-way petitioner seeking an object.
changed_reading.after: The asker may also be an interlocutor whose question creates a reciprocal obligation to remain answerable without verbal expulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from solar emergence to settled, covering night activates the daylight branch inside the focus verb. Rebuke can therefore be heard as coercive exposure: forcing a need that approached under cover into public glare. The prohibition acquires a privacy function alongside its ordinary speech function.

activation_trace.role: Asking supplies the potentially exposing act of making a need known.
Day opening with light supplies the latent exposure pole carried by the prohibited verb.
Emergence into sunlight supplies visible disclosure at the bright end of the contextual contrast.
Night and darkness supply the opposed condition in which visibility recedes.
Covering with a cloth supplies concealment as a protective rather than merely absent state.

structural_cues: The opening oath places bright emergence beside night when it settles, making visibility and cover an ordered contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, darkness, covering, and the focus root's daylight/rebuke polysemy; I infer that exposing a disclosed need can itself perform rebuke. A live alternative is that the light-night pair marks reassurance only, with no privacy implication.

changed_reading.before: Do not scold the asker after the request is spoken.
changed_reading.after: Do not punish disclosure by daylighting the asker or converting a privately revealed need into public exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negated abandonment and aversive distancing of 93:3, set against nurture and completion, make rebuke a relational action: it can cast a requester out before any material decision is made. The response must not reproduce abandonment in miniature.

activation_trace.role: The request supplies the moment at which continued relation is tested.
Harsh rebuke supplies the immediate verbal mechanism of driving someone back.
Leaving and letting go supply the abandoned relation that the context explicitly negates.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply the positive relational counterforce.
Casting or driving outward supplies the spatial effect that a rebuke can have on the requester.
Aversion that distances the heart supplies the affective withdrawal concealed inside dismissal.

structural_cues: The addressee assured of non-abandonment later becomes the stronger party in an encounter with an asker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leaving, nurture, outward expulsion, and heart-distance; I infer that verbal rebuke can enact those relations even without physical removal. A live alternative is that 93:3 consoles the addressee without directly defining conduct toward the asker.

changed_reading.before: Rebuke is objectionable because its tone is severe.
changed_reading.after: Rebuke is objectionable because it converts a response into abandonment, expulsion, and affective withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later/better/earlier comparison introduces a time horizon into the request. A beneficial answer may be delayed, but the split inventory of the earlier term also activates return-to-outcome and proximity without a gap. Thus non-fulfillment now need not become rejection: delay should preserve nearness, attention, and a route to an outcome.

activation_trace.role: The sought request supplies an unmet object whose answer may unfold over time.
Harsh rebuke supplies the false closure that can make postponement feel like rejection.
Deferral to a later time supplies a legitimate temporal gap between request and outcome.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the criterion by which a later answer could exceed an immediate one.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies continuity between the first request and its later resolution.
Proximity without an intervening gap supplies the relational nearness that should survive delay.

structural_cues: The explicit comparison between later and earlier precedes the future promise of giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal delay, beneficial outcome, return, and proximity; I infer a response protocol in which timing may change while relation remains open. A live alternative is that the comparison concerns only the addressee's destiny and says nothing about delayed requests.

changed_reading.before: The command governs only the immediate words spoken to an asker.
changed_reading.after: It also governs deferred response: inability to answer now must not be communicated as final expulsion or relational distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving, nurturing completion, and reciprocal satisfaction activate a positive horizon behind the negative command. The encounter should remain oriented toward a fitting response that can restore satisfaction, while the grammar still stops short of requiring the grant of every requested object.

activation_trace.role: The sought object supplies what the asker hopes will be answered.
Fulfillment of a request supplies the strongest possible endpoint without making it automatic.
Harsh rebuke supplies the response mode that would contradict this constructive horizon.
Handing over and giving supply a concrete response rather than a merely verbal absence of harm.
Nurture and completion supply a process calibrated to what actually repairs the asker's condition.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a relational measure of response beyond unilateral disposal of the case.

structural_cues: The future giving clause ends in satisfaction, creating an answer-shaped sequence before the prohibitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request, giving, nurture, and satisfaction; I infer that the negative command keeps the encounter oriented toward constructive answer. The live alternative is that non-rebuke requires dignity only and may coexist with a complete refusal.

changed_reading.before: Compliance ends once harsh speech is withheld.
changed_reading.after: Withholding rebuke is the minimum condition of a response process oriented toward fitting help and restored satisfaction, though not an unconditional grant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Being found in severed dependence and then gathered into refuge recasts the asker as someone at a social threshold. Rebuke is functionally an expulsion from possible shelter; non-rebuke keeps the threshold traversable and permits mercy to gather rather than scatter.

activation_trace.role: The request supplies the threshold-crossing approach toward someone able to respond.
Driving back with harsh speech supplies the verbal form of exclusion from that threshold.
Encountering and finding supply the moment when hidden vulnerability becomes another party's responsibility.
Severance from a guardian supplies the social disconnection that makes access to refuge consequential.
Joining a gathering place that shelters supplies the spatial reversal of being driven away.
Tender mercy toward one who evokes concern supplies the affective mode of receiving the approach.

structural_cues: The remembered condition is immediately followed by its remedy: severed dependence becomes shelter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finding, severance, shelter, mercy, and verbal driving-back; I infer that the asker's approach is threshold-like and that rebuke can deny refuge before goods are considered. A live alternative is that shelter applies specifically to orphanhood, not to every kind of asking.

changed_reading.before: The asker is a generic petitioner who should receive civil speech.
changed_reading.after: The asker may be a person testing whether a sheltering social threshold is open; rebuke would close that threshold and repeat severance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The found-straying-guided sequence activates an epistemic asker: one who asks because direction is missing. Since guidance is explicitly gentle in its branch inventory, the prohibition governs pedagogy as well as almsgiving; uncertainty is to be met with direction, not punished by verbal force.

activation_trace.role: Asking supplies inquiry for information or direction as well as request for a material object.
Harsh rebuke supplies the punitive answer that can make admitted uncertainty unsafe.
Finding someone supplies recognition of the questioner's actual location before direction is offered.
Straying from guidance or aim supplies the directional deficit that can generate a question.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the constructive mode of answering disorientation.

structural_cues: The condition-and-remedy syntax moves directly from straying to guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asking, directional loss, and gentle guidance; I infer that some askers disclose not-knowing and that the remembered remedy becomes a norm for answering them. A live alternative is that the context narrates the addressee's history without expanding the asker's category.

changed_reading.before: The asker is primarily someone requesting property or aid.
changed_reading.after: The asker can coexist as a knowledge-seeker whose uncertainty calls for gentle orientation rather than shaming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The found-need-sufficiency sequence makes asking a diagnostic signal of a sufficiency gap, possibly carrying dependents beyond the visible speaker. Rebuke is not only harmful speech; it can close access to the very relation through which scarcity becomes adequacy.

activation_trace.role: The sought request supplies an articulated lack rather than an abstract social category.
Driving back with harsh speech supplies a way of closing access before need is assessed.
Finding supplies attentive detection of need rather than waiting for it to become louder.
Poverty and want supply the concrete deficit that can stand behind a request.
Dependents and those one supports supply a hidden downstream scope beyond the visible asker.
Sufficiency supplies the remedial endpoint without reducing it to wealth alone.

structural_cues: A detected condition of need is followed immediately by a causative movement into sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finding, poverty, dependents, sufficiency, and verbal exclusion; I infer that keeping access open is part of not worsening the deficiency. A live alternative is that the prohibition guarantees respectful hearing but no transfer of resources.

changed_reading.before: Not rebuking is a self-contained verbal courtesy.
changed_reading.after: Not rebuking preserves access through which an identified insufficiency, including the needs of dependents, may move toward adequacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearly mirrored constructions for the orphan and the asker transfer the vertical force of domination into the interpretation of rebuke. Harsh speech is prohibited not merely for unpleasantness but because it lets the socially higher party press down, humiliate, and sever a vulnerable person's access.

activation_trace.role: The act of asking supplies an asymmetry in which one party exposes dependence to another.
Harsh verbal driving-back supplies the asker's member of the paired prohibitions.
Earlier severance from a guardian supplies remembered vulnerability before it becomes an ethical category.
The repeated severed-dependent category supplies the counterpart placed in parallel with the asker.
Conquest from above that subdues and humiliates supplies the power geometry transferred across the syntactic mirror.

structural_cues: The adjacent clauses repeat the marked-topic and negative-imperative frame: orphan/do not dominate, then asker/do not rebuke.
The orphan category first appears as remembered experience and then reappears as the object of a prohibition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactic mirroring, severed dependence, vertical domination, and verbal rebuke; I infer that the parallel makes rebuke one modality of domination. A live alternative is that the two prohibitions remain separate examples joined only by style.

changed_reading.before: Rebuke is wrong because it is impolite or emotionally painful.
changed_reading.after: Rebuke is wrong because, in this asymmetry, speech can enact domination from above and convert need into humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final command does not leave the response ethic at silence: softness and nurture culminate in renewed, revealing speech. Placed after the ban on rebuke, it activates a positive replacement mode in which speech keeps benefit circulating rather than using voice to eject the asker.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies an exchange that requires an answerable voice rather than mere silence.
Harsh rebuke supplies the destructive speech mode that the following imperative can replace.
Softness, ease, and well-being supply the texture of a non-rebuking response.
Nurture and completion supply a purpose for speech beyond self-display.
Speech renewed as news supplies an ongoing, generative alternative to a terminating rebuke.
Bringing something forth and making it visible supplies communicative disclosure of benefit.

structural_cues: The prohibition on harsh address is immediately followed by an imperative to speak, so the sequence contrasts modes of voice rather than speech with silence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies softness, nurture, renewed speech, disclosure, and rebuke; I infer that the last imperative models a constructive answer-mode for the preceding encounter. A live alternative is that speaking of favor is a separate public duty unrelated to answering the asker.

changed_reading.before: The safe response is simply to suppress harsh words.
changed_reading.after: The sequence invites replacement speech: soft, answerable, and generative language through which received benefit can continue toward another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the asker's root together with a remote snatching branch of the prohibited verb. It remains anchored to both focus words and clarifies the vulnerability of disclosure; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for asker or rebuke.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The asker at word 2 activates a split image of gently drawing something hidden out, while the prohibited verb at word 4 activates sudden snatching as well as rebuke.

activation_trace.role: Gentle, concealed drawing-out supplies an image for a question or request bringing hidden need into speech.
A sudden or stealthy snatch supplies the violent reversal by which the response seizes control of a delicate disclosure.
Harsh verbal rebuke keeps the material analogy attached to the actual prohibited speech act.

changed_reading.before: A request arrives as an already explicit demand and receives either assent or refusal.
changed_reading.after: Asking may delicately draw a concealed need into view; rebuke violates that emergence by turning it into a sudden seizure of control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one contextual root splits into dominant gentle guidance and non-dominant threat or intimidation, a form-distant activation. activation_trace.role: Chainlike connection supplies a model in which the visible request is linked to people and needs not present in the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The command concerns a closed, two-person exchange.
changed_reading.after: The visible asker may carry a hidden dependency chain, so rebuke can propagate exclusion beyond the person standing at the door.

strongest_changes: The adjacent orphan/asker syntax changes rebuke from mere rudeness into a verbal form of domination, expulsion, and humiliation.
The remembered remedies of shelter, guidance, and sufficiency allow the asker to coexist as refuge-seeker, knowledge-seeker, and bearer of material need.
The light/night and river/opening branches add privacy and channel mechanics: do not expose disclosed need or erode the route by which it can receive an answer.
The final speech imperative changes non-rebuke from silence into a positive ecology of soft, answerable, benefit-bearing speech.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support several mechanisms at once: direct verbal restraint, social non-expulsion, hydraulic channel preservation, epistemic gentleness, temporal stewardship, and protection of hidden dependency networks. The split mappings produced useful but containable surprises rather than forcing a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The split-root activations involving gentle extraction, chain linkage, and threat are form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The prohibition itself does not settle whether any particular request must be granted; dignity, access, and constructive orientation are firmer than unconditional provision.

Some contextual transformations may primarily narrate the addressee's history rather than classify every possible asker, so the refuge, guidance, and sufficiency readings should coexist rather than displace one another.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Question/request must meet non-rebuke.** Evidence: س ء ل B001/B002 (asking/requesting; requested thing), ن ه ر B004 (harsh verbal rebuke), ع ط و B002/B005 in 93:5 (giving; asking for gift), ر ض و B003 in 93:5 (mutual consent). Structural cue: the promised giving of 93:5 becomes a command about another asker. Mechanism: the packet supplies request and rebuke branches; I supply the ethical conversion from being a recipient to receiving a requester. Abductive move: a request is not an offense to be driven back; it is the human mirror of promised giving. Reading change: the ayah regulates tone and reception, not just material response.

2. **Do not dam the river-channel of need.** Evidence: ن ه ر B001 (river cutting ground with flowing water), ن ه ر B003 (opening/widening until flow), س ء ل B002/B003 (sought request; fulfilling request), ن ع م B001 in 93:11 (bestowed favor). Structural cue: the rebuke verb carries a watercourse branch, and the next ayah names favor. Mechanism: the packet supplies flow/opening branches; I supply the metaphor that speech can open or block the channel through which need is expressed and met. Abductive move: harsh rebuke is a social dam that stops the flow of asking before favor can circulate. Reading change: "do not nahr" means do not close the channel; keep need speakable.

3. **Daylight speech without harsh glare.** Evidence: ن ه ر B002 (day opening with light), ض ح و B002/B005 in 93:1 (sun-exposure; clear brightness), ح د ث B006 in 93:11 (disclosure), ق ه ر B001 in 93:9 (overpowering from above). Structural cue: the surah's light-images culminate in a speech command but are bounded by prohibitions against overpowering and rebuke. Mechanism: the packet supplies daylight/opening and harsh speech branches; I supply the contrast that making visible must not become humiliating exposure. Abductive move: not every "daylight" disclosure is merciful; illumination must be softened by رحمة. Reading change: the command protects the asker from being exposed under a punitive light.

4. **No sudden snatch of dignity.** Evidence: ن ه ر B006 (sudden snatch/stealth taking), ق ه ر B001 in 93:9 (forced taking without consent), س م و B005/B008 in 93:0 (raised name/repute), ح د ث B004 in 93:11 (becoming what people tell). Structural cue: a requester is socially exposed; later narration can preserve or damage public mention. Mechanism: the packet supplies sudden-taking and reputation/talk branches; I supply the dignity relation that harsh answer steals standing in a moment. Abductive move: rebuke can take from the asker before any material refusal occurs. Reading change: "لا تنهر" prohibits verbal theft of dignity as much as verbal harshness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 93:11 immediately made the speech dimension unavoidable: the mouth forbidden to rebuke is commanded to narrate favor. That made ن ه ر B001/B003 surprisingly important, because favor needs an open channel; the command is not just "be polite" but "do not block the flow by which need and blessing can circulate."

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The second prohibition protects the requester's verbal access.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `س ء ل:B001` is asking or requesting, and fixed `ن ه ر:B004` is driving someone back with harsh speech. **Structural cue:** the clause parallels 93:9, where physical/social domination through `ق ه ر:B001` is forbidden; here the instrument is speech. **Assigned role:** asking opens a claim; rebuke closes access before the claim can be heard. **Abductive move:** I infer harsh reception → practical exclusion, not merely hurt feeling; the packet supplies the asker and rebuke but not the downstream effect. **Reading change:** `فَلَا تَنْهَرْ` safeguards the channel by which need or inquiry becomes audible.

2. **The requester is viewed from the side of possible fulfillment.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `س ء ل:B002` is the sought request, and fixed `س ء ل:B003` is fulfilling a request; 93:5 supplies giving through `ع ط و:B002`, while 93:8 supplies sufficing through `غ ن ي:B002`. **Structural cue:** the addressee's receipt and increased capacity precede the encounter with the asker. **Assigned role:** the request branch identifies the claim; the fulfillment branch supplies its desired completion; prior giving supplies possible means. **Abductive move:** I infer received and sufficient capacity → orientation toward answering, while recognizing that the explicit command states only non-rebuke. **Reading change:** the ayah's minimum prohibition carries a positive horizon: hear the request as something that may be met.

3. **A latent flow-image opposes blocking speech.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ن ه ر:B001` is a river cutting a channel with flowing water, fixed `ن ه ر:B003` is opening or widening until something flows, and 93:11 activates report/conversation through `ح د ث:B003`. **Structural cue:** asking is followed by commanded speech about favor, within a window already structured by giving and sufficiency. **Assigned role:** the river/opening branches provide a material model for unblocked movement of request, response, and report. **Abductive move:** I infer communicative access behaves like a channel that harsh rebuke can dam; this is an analogy, not a claim that `تَنْهَرْ` directly means “dam a river.” **Reading change:** non-rebuke becomes maintenance of an open social and verbal flow rather than mere avoidance of a rude tone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 93:11 supplied the only later ayah and the decisive surprise: its positive command to report (`ح د ث:B003`) corrected “do not rebuke” from mere silence toward constructive speech. That speech also activated the opening/flow scopes of fixed `ن ه ر:B001` and `ن ه ر:B003`, although the channel relation remains an explicit material analogy.

findings.text: Azarlama yasağı, isteğin daha duyulmadan kapatılmasını önleyerek ihtiyaç veya sorunun sözle ulaşabileceği kanalı korur.
İstenen şey ve isteği yerine getirme boyutları, yasağın ötesinde olumlu bir imkan açar: talep, karşılanması düşünülebilecek bir çağrı olarak dinlenmelidir.
Nehir ve akış için kanal açma çağrışımları, sert sözü istek, cevap ve nimetin dolaşımını kesen bir engel gibi gösterir.
Günün ışıkla açılması boyutu, isteyeni görünür kılmanın onu sert ve küçük düşürücü bir teşhire dönüştürmemesi gerektiğini düşündürür.
Ansızın çekip alma çağrışımı, azarı isteyenden daha maddi bir cevap verilmeden önce onun saygınlığını çalan bir davranış olarak gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Daylight, Night, and Stilling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bright daytime opens and extends, then night covers the scene and settles into stillness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forenoon supplies both duration and radiance, while night supplies darkness and `سَجَىٰ` supplies the act of becoming still. The lexical opening of daylight completes a cycle in which illumination expands, darkness arrives, and motion subsides.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerability is encountered and answered through shelter, nurture, provision, and responsive giving rather than neglect or rebuke.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The surface sequence of rescue and command expands into a full economy of guardianship, sufficiency, fulfilled requests, and anti-neglect.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Request, Grant, and Gentle Reception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A requester names a need, seeks a gift, receives a grant, and is not driven away by harsh speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: asking and seeking `س ء ل:B001/m01`; desired object `س ء ل:B002/m01`; fulfillment of a request `س ء ل:B003/m01`; giving `ع ط و:B002/m01`; solicitation for a gift `ع ط و:B005/m01`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; affectionate present `ه د ي:B004/m01`; harsh rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The requested object gives asking a goal, solicitation initiates transfer, giving and the affectionate present answer it, and fulfillment completes it. Harsh rebuke is the rejected counter-action that would break this exchange at its opening.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social relations are stabilized through pact, consent, protection, and surety, or ruptured through coercion and hostile dominance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Satisfaction unfolds into bilateral accord, legal guarantee, protected status, truce, and contested victory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coercion, Contest, and Cessation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Opponents drive, seize, or overpower one another until conflict is restrained by cessation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: coercive domination `ق ه ر:B001/m01`; victory in contest `ع ط و:B007/m01`; overcoming a rival `ر ض و:B005/m01`; expulsion or driving out `ق ل ي:B002/m01`; stealthy snatching `ن ه ر:B006/m01`; armistice `و د ع:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Driving and snatching initiate dispossession, contest turns it into reciprocal struggle, and coercion fixes a victor over a subdued party. Armistice is the social mechanism that interrupts this chain without requiring either side's annihilation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Question, Answer, and Mutual Consultation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Participants ask one another, answer affirmatively, exchange news, and reach an agreed response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reciprocal questioning `س ء ل:B004/m01`; affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`; renewed speech or news `ح د ث:B003/m01`; mutual accord `ر ض و:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reciprocal questioning opens the exchange, renewed speech supplies its content, affirmation answers it, and mutual accord gives the conversation a shared outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Layered Cloud, Soft Wind, and Green Persistence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clouds gather and linger, a soft moist wind moves beneath them, and vegetation remains green.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: layered raincloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; lingering weather `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; soft south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sorma ve isteme eylemlerini kapsar; istenen şeyin kendisini, isteğin karşılanmasını ve karşılıklı sormayı ayrı dallara bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sorma ve isteme eylemlerini birlikte verir; doğrudan nesneli kullanımda bir şey istenirken, bir konu veya kişi hakkında kurulan kullanımda bilgi aranır. Eylem adı, çok soran kimse ve yardım isteyen kişi de aynı tanıklık kümesinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, kişi tarafından istenmiş olan şeyle sınırlıdır; henüz istek olarak ortaya konmamış dilek ve isteme eyleminin kendisi kapsam dışındadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın istediği, kendisine verilmesini ya da gerçekleşmesini talep ettiği şeydir. Bir dileğe yakın olabilir, ancak burada belirleyici olan onun gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğun üyelerinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini açıkça bildirir. Karşılıklılık yalnızca aynı ortamda birden çok soru bulunması değildir; katılımcıların soran ve kendisine sorulan rollerini birbirlerine göre üstlenmesi dalın kurucu özelliğidir.

facets.statement: Birden çok katılımcının birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve soru rollerini karşılıklı üstlenmesini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, biçimi kişilerin birbirlerine soru sorması olarak açıklar. Bu açıklama, genel soru eylemine karşılıklı katılım ve rollerin katılımcılar arasında değişmesi koşulunu ekler.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi ve bu yolla bilgi edinme amacını bağlam içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok konuşanın aynı konuda karşılıklı iletişim kurmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda tarafların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi zorunludur. Komşu dal karşılıklı konuşma ve bir konuyu birlikte ele alma sürecidir; soru-cevap yapısı onun kurucu koşulu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok kişinin söz alıp birbirine yöneldiği konuşma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal soru türünü ve karşılıklı yönelmeyi tanımlar; komşu dal konuşma sırasının el değiştirmesini tanımlar. Karşılıklı sorular eşzamanlı bir alışverişte bulunabilir, sırayla konuşma ise sorusuz da olabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça gizli hırsızlık ve evden hırsızlık amacıyla alma olarak tanımlar. Rüşvet yalnızca bir biçimin ek kullanımında geçer ve dalın hırsızlık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan çekip çıkarmadan suç amacı ve gizlilik koşuluyla ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş biçimlerdeki gizli hırsızlık alanına bağlıdır; bu alan yalın çekip çıkarma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, özellikle bir evden, gizlice ve hırsızlık amacıyla almaktır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gizlilik ve hırsızlık amacı taşıyan alma eyleminin çekirdek karşılığıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çocuk ve hayvan yavrusunu, ayrıca bir kökten çekilip alınan öz ya da üreme maddesini aynı çıkış ilişkisi altında toplar. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün öğelerin doğrudan soy anlamına gelmediği açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ortaklık, bir kökenden çıkmış olma ilişkisidir; kişi soyu ile maddi öz birbirine eşitlenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş adların kökenden çıkma ortaklığını verir; yavru ve maddi öz kullanımlarını ayrı alt alanlar olarak korur.

facets.statement: Taşkın ya da bol suyu taşıyan ve toprağı yararak belirginleşen doğal bir su yatağıdır.

Su yatağının kendine sağlam ve yerleşik bir güzergah edinmesi yapı bağlı bir kullanımdır.
Suyun kazıp oluşturduğu belirli yatak yeri de bu dal içinde adlandırılır.
Kuyu kazısının yer altındaki su düzeyine ulaşması, suya varma sonucunu bildiren bağlı bir kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği bir şeyi açmak, yarığını genişletmek veya içindekini serbestçe akacak hale getirmektir. Geçici dal imgesi kullanılabilir, ancak her örnekte akış sonucu bulunmadığından genişleme ve açıklık yönü akıştan bağımsız olarak da korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Akış, kan ve bağırsak kullanımlarında belirgindir; açık alan ve yarık genişletmede ise kurucu öğe açıklık veya genişliktir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel açılma ve genişleme çekirdeği korunur; kan, yara, açık alan ve bağırsak kullanımları kendi biçim ve yapılarına bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi açmak, yarığını genişletmek veya içindekini akacak biçimde serbest bırakmaktır. Bu çekirdek kan akıtma, yara açıklığını büyütme, açık alan, bağırsak boşalması ve genişlik ya da aydınlık benzetmelerinde özelleşir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin açılması, açılması için yarılması veya mevcut açıklığının genişletilmesi temel ilişkidir.
Kanı açılan bir yerden serbest bırakıp akıtma, çekirdeğin akış sonuçlu özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir yaranın veya yarığın açıklığını büyütmek, genişletme çekirdeğinin özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Evlerin önleri arasında kalan ve atıkların bırakıldığı açık alan, açıklık sonucunun adlaşmış uzantısıdır.
Bağırsağın çözülüp akarsu gibi boşalması, akış benzetmesine bağlı bedensel bir kullanımdır.
Genişlik, kimi açıklamalarda su yatağına benzetilir; başka bir anlatımda aydınlıkla birlikte anılır.
Tehlikeler için kullanılan bir biçim, iki ayrı söz öğesinin kaynaştırılmasıyla açıklanan tartışmalı bir türetmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt açma ve genişletme çekirdeğini kanın akıtılması, yara açıklığının büyütülmesi ve bir şeyin genişlemesiyle kurar. Açık alan, bağırsak boşalması, genişlik ve aydınlık anlatımları ile birleşik türetme açıklaması bu çekirdeğin farklı uzantılarıdır.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: Ordered surface alignment within canonical QAC words; only spans shared by all best alignments are joined. Upstream word-analysis identities and wording are preserved. Unresolved analytic units remain available for qualified reading; never infer their QAC identity from upstream numbering.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
